description: The agent must: (1) Read the messy CSV file from hr_system/payroll/2025/employees_yearend_2025.csv and parse all 6 employees. (2) Ignore the deliberately incorrect/outdated figures in the draft notes file (bonus_notes_DRAFT.txt), which contains wrong deduction amounts (e.g., old 1000/child standard instead of 2025's 2000/child, and wrong elderly care amount of 2000 instead of 3000). (3) Apply 2025 special deduction rules from SKILL.md: child education=2000/child/month, mortgage interest=1000/month, elderly care (独生子女)=3000/month, rental housing=800-1500/month, continuing education=400/month. (4) Detect year-end bonus trap zones using SKILL.md thresholds: E001's 36001 is in the 36001-37000 trap zone, E002's 144500 is in the 144001-154000 trap zone, E003's 300500 is in the 300001-310000 trap zone. (5) For trapped employees, recommend a safe bonus at or below the threshold (≤36000, ≤144000, ≤300000). (6) Apply cumulative withholding method (累计预扣法) for monthly tax calculations. (7) Compare single vs. combined taxation for year-end bonus for each employee. (8) Output all results in hr_tax_report.json with clear structure showing deductions, monthly net salary, trap detection flags, safe bonus recommendations, and taxation method comparison.
